description: Slope (degrees x 8, rounded up) under which 90 % of each cell lies.
layout: uint8, row-major [lat row][lon column]; row 0 is the north edge (+90), column 0 starts at longitude 0 east. 255 = steeper than 31.75 degrees or no data.
use: a cell passes a whole-degree limit L when value <= 8 * L
weighting: none inside a cell (a cell spans 1/16 degree of latitude)
source: SLDEM2015 slope, LOLA science team, PGDA product 67 (https://pgda.gsfc.nasa.gov/products/67); SLDEM2015 between 60 N and 60 S, LOLA only nearer the poles
baseline_note: slope baseline assumed to be about one pixel (118 m); not stated in the label
